traits.name: Web Sense
traits.text: The dream spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

traits.name: Dream Spider Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 4 rounds Stage 1 stupefied 1 (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison damage plus stupefied 1 (1 round)

traits.name: Web Trap
traits.text: A creature hit by the dream spider's web attack is immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface until it Escapes (DC 16).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ bite +7 (finesse); Damage 1d6 (1d6) plus dream spider venom

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ web +7 (range increment 10 feet); Damage web trap plus dream spider venom
